overview: This breakout session of the Medford High School Building Project community forum focused on climate, energy, and atmosphere considerations, specifically discussing geothermal energy options, life cycle cost analyses, solar carport proposals, and project timelines.

items.title: First Breakout Session: Climate, Energy, and Atmosphere Discussion
items.summary: Participants discussed geothermal well locations under deed-restricted land, upcoming test well drilling, 50-year life cycle cost analyses (LCCA), and the potential inclusion of solar carports.

items.title: Second Breakout Session: Climate, Energy, and Atmosphere Discussion
items.summary: The group discussed design and budget challenges, including navigating the state's Article 97 permitting process for geothermal wells on deed-restricted land and the logistics of temporary heating and cooling during construction.

subject: High School Sustainability Breakout Session
